title: Cut the Windows cost of the coordinator test files
goal: The Windows npm test step finishes within 12 minutes: the coordinator files no longer run 10-30 times slower there than on Linux
acceptance: The slowest Windows files are measured against Linux from the timing logs of 2026-11-24/25 and the Windows-only cost named

The test processes skip SQLite's disk flush (a test preload, covered by its own test), and the partition mesh's registry sync opens each store once per round; no timeout raised, no test skipped, product code unchanged
The PR's Windows run shows the coordinator files' times against the 20 runs before; then five full Windows runs within 12 minutes without reruns (B-118's Check)
Pending cases this change makes (listed for check:gauntlet-runs): multi-step-agent/*; rerunning them is an owner-approved gauntlet run (package.json and test/ are their source inputs)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: CI windows job timings against runs 45511684500-45559316942
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
If the flush is not the Windows cost, the next step (fewer store opens in promote's 5 s horizon poll, src/coordinator-promote.ts) changes product code and gets its own task and review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: aggregate 20 Windows timing logs, compare with Linux, count store opens, two test-side changes, measure on the PR. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.

prs.note: test preload without SQLite flush; partition sync opens each store once per round
